_comment: The single conformance corpus hook_identity.lua and the hook-registration-path lint (via hook_identity_cli.lua) are both pinned against. Every row's expected_identity is the literal M.identity(command, type) return value; null means the command is identity-ineligible (the mandatory carve-out -- never matched, moved, deduped, or swept). See hook_identity.lua's own doc comment for the full eligibility rules this corpus pins.

rows.note: CWD-relative, no .claude/ at all -- the live host-repo orphan instance. Eligible under Rule 2 (plain relative *.sh invocation).
The ~/-anchored form of the same script. Must remain nil -- the mandatory carve-out. Live in ModelBuilder, Logos/Website, Logos/Theory.
Bare CWD-relative anchor of a hooks/ hook.

$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-prefixed anchor of the SAME hook as the row above -- must collapse to the identical identity (the original production-defect fix merge.lua's hook_identity() already provided, preserved unchanged).
Absolute-path anchor of the same hooks/ hook -- collapses to the same identity as the two rows above.

rows.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r ".file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *"specs/state.json"* ]]; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/validate-state-sync.sh 2>/dev/null || echo "{}"; else echo "{}"; fi'
rows.note: bash -c wrapped registration -- the innermost invoked *.sh token is found regardless of nesting.

Hand-written custom hook: an absolute path containing no .claude/ substring. Must remain nil under today's (narrow) behavior and under this broadened function alike -- no real source-store script is ever registered this way, so this shape is definitionally a user's own hook. The single most dangerous possible regression in the sweep this module backs would be treating this as eligible.
An mcpServers-style command value with no *.sh invocation at all.

Identity-eligible and source-store-shaped, but undeclared by any fragment under this matcher in the field (ModelBuilder/Logos-Website Stop|* orphan) -- orphanhood is a valid_set question, not an eligibility one.
Identity-eligible; the script no longer exists anywhere in the source store (superseded by wezterm-clear-task-number.sh). Field orphan in ModelBuilder/Logos-Website/Logos-Theory.
